verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk registry extracts or datasets is a fair capability to ask of a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has only two probes, each showing HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing beyond those walls was fetched. There is therefore no evidence of any documented bulk download, dataset, or registry extract. Confidence is low because the probes record access walls rather than confirming that no bulk-data offering exists.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
